newsitem.title: DUBAI: Saudi Arabia beheads Saudi man for killing six.
newsitem.headline: Saudi Arabia beheads Saudi man for killing six.

text.p: Saudi Arabia beheaded a Saudi man on Friday for shooting to death six of his colleagues over a dispute, Saudi state television reported.
It quoted an interior ministry statement as saying the man had also injured a seventh co-worker at his place of work over the unspecified dispute.
It did not say where the man worked.
The beheading in the northwestern city of Tabuk brought to 48 the number of people executed in Saudi Arabia this year.
The conservative kingdom strictly enforces Islamic sharia law by publicly beheading by the sword convicted murderers, drug smugglers, rapists and other criminals.
